workResult.summary: Executed only Skill 04 Research Analysis after fail-closed admission, deterministic SHA-256 verification of the authoritative generated Analysis prompt, complete reading of all seven required control/editorial/evidence sources, durable same-date Wake Receipt verification, repository-granted global-serial execution authority and a verified Worker Claimed event. Consumed only the three completed 2026-08-28 Reading Results and produced exactly three Research Objects. Q-20260828-01 concludes that delegated resource governance should preserve two linked identities: descendant workers remain the origin of measured resource use while the root objective that authorized delegation remains the owner of the inherited budget charge; the selected Codex evidence proves robust root token attribution across nesting, idle progress, goal replacement, checkpoint concurrency and an unloaded intermediate parent, but not immediate descendant cancellation, generalized multi-resource quotas or distributed exactly-once charging. Q-20260828-02 concludes that cache validity and authority admissibility are separate: when governing policy explicitly requires fresh remote authority, stale managed policy can remain stored evidence but must not silently retain authorization power; the selected Copilot CLI release note provides bounded product-level evidence for a restrictive undetermined state on named capabilities, not source-level proof of freshness identity, authentication or validation internals. Q-20260828-03 concludes that cached approval evidence should be bound to the authorization identity under which it was produced and revalidated at consumption time; the Guardian v2 evidence demonstrates revocation-aware invalidation, including authorization changing while classification is in flight, but authorization-version equality proves only the authority dimensions represented by that tuple. No prior-day research input, fixed article outline, forced first-party mapping, article drafting, visualization, Publication Candidate creation or publication was used or performed.
workResult.summary_zh: 在完成 Fail-closed Admission、权威 Generated Analysis Prompt 的 SHA-256 确定性核验、全部 7 个 Required Control/Editorial/Evidence Source 的完整读取、同日 Wake Receipt 持久核验、仓库授予的全局串行执行权与 Worker Claimed 核验后，仅执行 Skill 04 Research Analysis。只消费 2026-08-28 当日三份已完成 Reading Result，并恰好形成三份 Research Object。Q-20260828-01 的判断是：委派 Resource Governance 应保留两个关联 Identity——Descendant Worker 仍是被测 Resource Usage 的 Origin，而授权委派的 Root Objective 仍是继承 Budget Charge 的 Owner；所选 Codex 证据证明 Root Token Attribution 能跨越 Nesting、Idle Progress、Goal Replacement、Checkpoint Concurrency 与中间 Parent 卸载，但不能证明即时 Descendant Cancellation、通用 Multi-resource Quota 或分布式 Exactly-once Charging。Q-20260828-02 的判断是：Cache Validity 与 Authority Admissibility 必须分离；当 Governing Policy 明确要求 Fresh Remote Authority 时，Stale Managed Policy 可以继续作为 Stored Evidence 保留，但不能静默保留 Authorization Power；所选 Copilot CLI Release Note 为指定 Capability 进入限制性 Undetermined State 提供了有界 Product-level Evidence，但不是 Freshness Identity、Authentication 或 Validation 内部机制的源码级证明。Q-20260828-03 的判断是：Cached Approval Evidence 应绑定生成时的 Authorization Identity，并在消费时重新核验；Guardian v2 证据证明了 Revocation-aware Invalidation，包括 Classification In-flight 时 Authorization 发生变化，但 Authorization-version Equality 只能证明该 Tuple 实际表示的 Authority Dimension。未复用前一日研究输入，也未使用固定文章大纲、强行映射自有项目，未执行文章撰写、可视化、Publication Candidate 创建或发布。

researchObjects.judgment: Delegated resource consumption should preserve worker-level origin evidence while charging the root objective that owns the authorized work. Shared root token accounting closes a demonstrated delegation accounting escape hatch, but accurate attribution is not itself proof of cancellation, generalized quota enforcement or exactly-once charging.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 委派 Resource Consumption 应保留 Worker-level Origin Evidence，同时把消耗计入拥有授权工作的 Root Objective。共享 Root Token Accounting 关闭了一个已证明的 Delegation Accounting Escape Hatch，但准确 Attribution 本身不是 Cancellation、通用 Quota Enforcement 或 Exactly-once Charging 的证明。

researchObjects.judgment: When configuration participates in authorization, freshness is part of evidence admissibility. If current remote authority is explicitly required, stale cached policy may remain stored evidence but should not silently retain permission power; inability to confirm current authority should be represented as an explicit bounded undetermined state rather than an implicit stale fallback.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 当 Configuration 参与 Authorization 时，Freshness 是 Evidence Admissibility 的组成部分。如果明确要求 Current Remote Authority，Stale Cached Policy 可以继续作为 Stored Evidence 保留，但不应静默保留 Permission Power；无法确认当前 Authority 时，应表示为显式、有界的 Undetermined State，而不是隐式 Stale Fallback。

researchObjects.judgment: Reusable approval evidence should be bound to the authorization identity under which it was produced and revalidated immediately before it is converted into execution authority. Recency alone is insufficient; version equality remains only as complete as the authority dimensions encoded by the version tuple.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 可复用 Approval Evidence 应绑定生成时的 Authorization Identity，并在它被转换成 Execution Authority 前立即重新核验。仅 Recency 不够；Version Equality 的有效边界只覆盖 Version Tuple 实际编码的 Authority Dimension。
